killers.name: The Trapper
killers.powerDescription: Carry and place Bear Traps on the ground. Survivors who step into a trap are immobilized, screaming to reveal their location. They can free themselves over time or be helped by another Survivor.
killers.tip: Place traps near generators, windows, and pallets to intercept Survivors. Start each match collecting traps and pre-set key loops before chasing.

killers.name: The Wraith
killers.powerDescription: Ring the Wailing Bell to cloak or uncloak. While cloaked, the Wraith moves faster and has a reduced terror radius, but cannot attack. Uncloaking near a Survivor causes a brief speed burst.
killers.tip: Use your cloak to approach generators silently and surprise Survivors. Uncloak just before reaching a Survivor to land an easy hit with the speed burst.

killers.name: The Hillbilly
killers.powerDescription: Rev up the Chainsaw to sprint at high speed in a straight line. Hitting a Survivor with the chainsaw sprint instantly downs them. Overheat the chainsaw and it will be temporarily disabled.
killers.tip: Use the chainsaw to cross large distances quickly and to cut through open areas. Curve your path slightly to catch Survivors running along predictable routes.

killers.name: The Nurse
killers.powerDescription: Blink through walls, floors, and ceilings up to twice. After blinking, there is a brief window to attack before the fatigue hits. Chain blinks for maximum range.
killers.tip: Aim your blinks precisely — blink past walls to cut off loops. The learning curve is high but mastery allows you to counter every tile in the game. Practice predicting Survivor movement.

killers.name: The Shape
killers.powerDescription: Stalk Survivors to charge Evil Within through three tiers. Tier I has a tiny terror radius and very slow movement. Tier III grants instant-down attacks and lasts for a limited time.
killers.tip: Stalk multiple Survivors a little bit each to reach Tier III faster. Save Tier III for endgame or burst it early to secure hooks when Survivors least expect it.

killers.name: The Hag
killers.powerDescription: Plant phantasm traps on the ground. When a Survivor triggers a trap, a phantom copy teleports to that location. Hag can teleport directly to any triggered trap.
killers.tip: Build a web of traps around hooked Survivors to punish rescues. Use traps to zone Survivors off generators in 3-gen situations.

killers.name: The Doctor
killers.powerDescription: Emit static electricity in Treatment mode or switch to Punishment mode to lunge with a shock. Shocking Survivors increases their Madness level, causing hallucinations and screams.
killers.tip: Cycle between modes to keep Survivors in Madness. The constant screams and hallucinations disrupt their game enormously. Great against coordinated teams.

killers.name: The Huntress
killers.powerDescription: Carry up to 5 hatchets and throw them at Survivors from a distance. Hatchets must be picked up from lockers to restock. A direct hit injures or downs Survivors.
killers.tip: Practice leading your shots — aim slightly ahead of a running Survivor. Use hatchets to apply pressure across the map and to punish Survivors hiding behind thin cover.

killers.name: The Cannibal
killers.powerDescription: Rev the chainsaw to perform a long tantrum sweep that can hit multiple Survivors. Unlike Hillbilly, the tantrum sweeps in an arc but moves slowly. Overheat causes a stumble.
killers.tip: Use the chainsaw at pallets to deny Survivors safety without wasting time. The sweep is excellent in tight areas and for clearing groups of Survivors.

killers.name: The Nightmare
killers.powerDescription: Pull Survivors into the Dream World. Dreaming Survivors suffer hallucinations and are slowed by a debuff aura. Place Dream Snares or Dream Pallets to trap Survivors in your domain.
killers.tip: Prioritize pulling all Survivors into the Dream World early. Combine Dream Snares with your chase to catch Survivors who rely on pallets and windows.

killers.name: The Pig
killers.powerDescription: Crouch to become undetectable and ambush Survivors. Place a Reverse Bear Trap on a downed Survivor — they must find a Jigsaw Box to remove it before the Exit Gates are powered, or die.
killers.tip: Apply traps at end game to force Survivors to stay in the map. Use your ambush dash to pounce on Survivors who think they are safe behind obstacles.

killers.name: The Clown
killers.powerDescription: Throw bottles of Afterpiece Tonic to create clouds of gas that slow and intoxicate Survivors. An alternate bottle type accelerates the Clown himself. Combine both for devastating effects.
killers.tip: Use yellow bottles on yourself to quickly close gaps. Throw tonic clouds just ahead of running Survivors at loops to reduce their window of opportunity.

killers.name: The Spirit
killers.powerDescription: Phase Walk to become invisible and move at high speed through the environment. While phasing, audio cues from Survivors help track their location. End Phase Walk to reappear and strike.
killers.tip: Listen carefully during Phase Walk — running sounds and scratch marks reveal Survivor paths. Fake entering Phase to bait Survivors into making mistakes.

killers.name: The Legion
killers.powerDescription: Activate Feral Frenzy to sprint at high speed and stab multiple Survivors with the Deep Wound status. Hitting all Survivors in Frenzy restores power. Deep Wound counts down and must be mended.
killers.tip: Use Frenzy to hit multiple Survivors and waste their time mending. Apply Deep Wound early in the game to slow progress while you patrol generators.

killers.name: The Plague
killers.powerDescription: Vomit a stream of infectious bile to infect Survivors and Objects of Obsession. Infected Survivors gradually become fully infected, causing them to cough and bleed. Drink from infected fountains to upgrade Vile Purge to Corrupt Purge — a much more powerful version.
killers.tip: Let Survivors cleanse to gain Corrupt Purge, which instantly injures. Otherwise, infected Survivors become injured over time. Apply infection to multiple targets early.

killers.name: The Ghost Face
killers.powerDescription: Activate Night Shroud to become undetectable. Stalk Survivors to mark them — a marked Survivor is exposed and can be instantly downed. Survivors can break your shroud by looking at you.
killers.tip: Stalk from behind cover and obstacles to avoid being spotted. Prioritize marking one Survivor completely rather than spreading stalking across multiple targets.

killers.name: The Oni
killers.powerDescription: Absorb Blood Orbs from injured Survivors to charge Yamaoka's Wrath. Once full, activate Demon Dash to sprint at extreme speed, then transition to Demon Strike for an instant-down blow.
killers.tip: Injure Survivors early to collect Blood Orbs quickly. Save Demon Dash for long-distance chases or to catch Survivors who are trying to reset.

killers.name: The Deathslinger
killers.powerDescription: Fire a chained spear from a rifle to harpoon Survivors. A hit pulls the Survivor towards you, chaining them temporarily. Reel them in to land a basic attack, or the chain breaks if the Survivor reaches a pallet.
killers.tip: Aim through narrow corridors and gaps where Survivors must run in a straight line. Break line-of-sight quickly after shooting to prevent Survivors from countering by breaking the chain at pallets.

killers.name: The Executioner
killers.powerDescription: Carve trails of Torment on the ground with your great knife. Survivors who step on Torment trails receive the Torment status. Tormented Survivors can be sentenced to Cages of Atonement instead of hooks.
killers.tip: Caging Survivors denies perks like Decisive Strike and lets you place them anywhere on the map. Lay trails in advance at key loops to punish Survivors who run predictable paths.

killers.name: The Blight
killers.powerDescription: Rush forward in a fast sprint with Blighted Corruption. Collide with obstacles to redirect and chain up to 4 bounces before unleashing a Lethal Rush attack on a Survivor.
killers.tip: Master the bounce mechanics around common loops to redirect efficiently. The Blight rewards deep map knowledge — learn which obstacles give you the best angles to reach Survivors quickly.

killers.name: The Twins
killers.powerDescription: Release Victor from Charlotte's chest to hunt as the smaller twin. Victor can pounce on Survivors to down them. If Victor is killed by a Survivor, he returns to Charlotte. Charlotte moves slowly while Victor is out.
killers.tip: Use Victor to guard hooked Survivors while Charlotte patrols. Victor's pounce can win chases instantly but be careful — Survivors can crush Victor to deny you pressure.

killers.name: The Trickster
killers.powerDescription: Throw a rapid stream of laceration blades at Survivors. Enough hits fill the Laceration Meter, injuring or downing the Survivor. Activate Main Event to throw blades at extreme speed with no recoil.
killers.tip: Aim for the body, not the head, and throw continuously. Use walls and angles to funnel Survivors into blade paths. Save Main Event for when multiple Survivors are grouped.

killers.name: The Nemesis
killers.powerDescription: Strike Survivors with your tentacle to spread the T-Virus infection. Infected Survivors become more contaminated over time and are revealed to Nemesis when near him. Zombies also roam the map to pressure Survivors.
killers.tip: The zombies act as free map pressure — let them roam to interrupt generator work. Infect Survivors early and track them through your aura-reading ability.

killers.name: The Artist
killers.powerDescription: Summon a flock of crows that travel in a straight line. Survivors caught in the flock are damaged and revealed. Hold power to aim and release to fire. Surviving a flock hit triggers a scream.
killers.tip: Aim flocks through windows and over pallets to punish safe loops. Use the aura reveal to track Survivors around the map when not in chase.

killers.name: The Dredge
killers.powerDescription: Teleport between lockers at high speed. Nightfall progressively darkens the map, blinding Survivors and granting the Dredge extra speed. Manifest from a locker for a surprise attack.
killers.tip: Lock lockers to deny Survivors hiding spots and teleport destinations. Save your teleports for long-distance repositioning to generators where Survivors are working.

killers.name: The Skull Merchant
killers.powerDescription: Deploy up to 3 drones that scan for Survivors in a rotating radius. Detected Survivors are revealed and tagged with a Claw Trap. Claw-trapped Survivors are slowed when trying to heal or escape.
killers.tip: Place drones at generator hot spots to force Survivors to waste time disabling them. Use them to cover your blind spots during chase.

killers.name: The Unknown
killers.powerDescription: Fire projectiles of UVX substance that applies Hallucinations to Survivors. Hallucinated Survivors must look at The Unknown directly to remove the debuff or it persists and leads to a scream. Unknown disappears and reappears near Survivors under Hallucination.
killers.tip: Apply UVX then teleport away to confuse Survivors. They must stop moving to stare at you, buying you time. Mix teleports with chases to keep Survivors off balance.
